retrievalProfile.description: A medium shot of a male subject in a leather jacket against an urban brick backdrop with a vintage vehicle and stenciled display type.
triggerTerms: desaturated blue and white brick background

recipe.visualDefinition: A cool-toned, desaturated portrait featuring a man with long curly hair looking off-camera, positioned in front of a white brick wall and a vintage white car, with heavy blue stenciled text integrated into the background space.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in the left foreground balancing large text on the right background
Horizontal lines of the car and brickwork contrasting with the verticality of the subject
Warm skin and red shirt tones popping against a dominant cool blue and white palette
coreInvariants: White brick wall as the primary background texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the left third of the frame, facing right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast red shirt underneath the dark jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the right toward the large typography, then down to the vintage car.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant of the brick wall provides space for the display text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and pale blue (background and car)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark brown (leather jacket)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value in the background to make the dark foreground subject stand out.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a cool, washed-out blue cast

letterConstructionRules: Stencil gaps in the center of vertical and horizontal strokes
Tight letter spacing with slight overlapping
Rough, weathered texture to match the wall
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars are thick and blocky
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant typeface used for impact; no secondary type needed.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif stencil aesthetic.
Provides the military/industrial stencil feel with heavy weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with long blonde curly hair wearing a black leather jacket and red shirt, looking to the side. He is standing in front of a white brick wall and a vintage white 1960s car. The lighting is overcast and the colors are desaturated with a cool blue tint.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, heavy, cyan-blue stencil slab-serif text in the upper right quadrant. The text should have a weathered, printed-on-brick texture.

verificationChecks: Is the text integrated into the wall texture?
Is the color palette predominantly cool-toned?
Does the subject occupy the left side of the frame?
Is the typography heavy and stenciled?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color cast
mustRedesign: Original artist name and specific logos
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Believable integration of text on wall
avoid: Floating text that doesn't match the background perspective

postGenerationChecks: Check that the stencil gaps are visible in the typography.
Ensure the car looks weathered and fits the urban setting.
Verify the subject's gaze leads toward the text.
Confirm the red shirt provides a clear focal point.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated urban portrait with heavy, textured stencil typography placed in the negative space of a textured background.
